Internal service tokens for workers still rely on long-lived static secrets stored in the secret manager.
Migrate workers to short-lived JWTs issued by the internal identity service, with automatic refresh before expiry.
Rotate out static secrets after all worker fleets present JWTs and revoke the old credentials.
